'''Rendili StarDrive''' was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]]-manufacturing company based on the planet [[Rendili/Legends|Rendili]]. One of the ancient [[Founding Shipwright]]s,<ref name="TEGTVAV">''[[The Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref> it was the primary supplier of ships to the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] for millennia until it was eclipsed in the final centuries of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] by [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]].<ref name="TEGTW" />

==History==
===Early history===
StarDrive was associated with companies such as [[Rendili Vehicle Corporation/Legends|Rendili Vehicle Corporation]],<ref name="QOTE">''[[Queen of the Empire]]''</ref> [[Vaufthau Shipyards Ltd.|Rendili/Vaufthau Shipyards LTD.]],<ref name="HSATCSSB" /> and [[Surron StarTech|Rendili-Surron]].<ref name="P&P">''[[Pirates & Privateers]]''</ref> [[Rendili StarDrive/Legends|Rendili Star Systems]] was apparently a subsidiary of Rendili StarDrive.

Dating back to the founding of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], Rendili was a planet synonymous with starship construction, and StarDrive was the latest incarnation of a variety of companies based on the planet, including [[Rendili Hyperworks/Legends|Rendili Hyperworks]], which had designed the [[Hammerhead-class cruiser|''Hammerhead''-class cruiser]] for the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] during the [[Old Sith Wars]]. Rendili prided itself on efficiency and reliability rather than cutting-edge innovation, reusing designs from a variety of cultures and eras and acquiring rights to technologies as they became widespread in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The company's ''Hammerhead''-class cruisers and [[Praetorian-class frigate|''Praetorian''-class frigates]] served in Republic and [[Planetary Security Forces|planetary defense]] fleets for more than a millennium.<ref name="TEGTW" />

===The decline of the Republic===
[[File:Dreadnaught_2048x1380.png|thumb|left|200px|A Rendili StarDrive ''Dreadnaught''-class cruiser]]
In the aftermath of the [[Ruusan Reformations/Legends|Ruusan Reformations]], the corporation developed an extensive system of smaller yards spread throughout the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] and [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] by licensing its designs to hundreds of Rim planets.<ref name="AOTC:ICS">''[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones Incredible Cross-Sections]]''</ref><ref name="TEGTW" /> While continuing to supply [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]] to the [[Judicial Forces/Legends|Judicial Forces]], Rendili also focused its efforts on supplying patrol craft for the [[Planetary Security Forces]].<ref name="TEGTW" />

In the Republic's final centuries, StarDrive developed a pronounced rivalry with [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]] (KDY). [[Kuat/Legends|Kuat]] had a long history of building sector defense warships and mercantile escorts, but lacked Rendili's prestige. KDY poured trillions of [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] into producing massive new [[Battleship/Legends|battleship]] designs, including the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]], [[Battlecruiser/Legends|Battlecruiser]], and [[Star Dreadnought/Legends|Star Dreadnought]] lines, advertising them to the [[Senator/Legends|senators]] of rich [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] sectors as far more effective combatants than undersized patrol craft.<ref name="TEGTW" />

StarDrive saw battleships as oversized trophy craft, noting that the capital ship restrictions of the Ruusan Reformations prevented them from operating beyond their home [[Sector/Legends|sectors]], and believed that there was no threat in the galaxy that justified such enormous warships. Around [[100 BBY/Legends|100 BBY]], StarDrive unveiled the [[Dreadnaught-class heavy cruiser/Legends|''Dreadnaught''-class heavy cruiser]], intended for Judicial task forces and to act as [[Flagship/Legends|flagships]] for Planetary Security Forces.<ref name="ISB" /> The design was a success, but was mired in fiasco when the Republic's [[Katana fleet|''Katana'' fleet]], composed entirely of ''Dreadnaught''-class cruisers, was afflicted with a [[hive virus]] and disappeared after the fleet's [[slave circuit]] caused the entire fleet to jump to [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] to parts unknown.<ref name="TEGTW" /><ref name="TNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref>

===The Clone Wars===
The tempo of [[Space warfare/Legends|space warfare]] had changed, and it was Kuat Drive Yards that was awarded the [[Project Icefang/Legends|secret contract]] to build the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic's]] warships and vehicles. After the Grand Army was unveiled on [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]], [[Arch-Provost/Legends|Arch-Provost]] [[Bengila Urlan]] of Rendili ordered industrial spies and [[Slicer/Legends|slicers]] to steal KDY's secrets and designs in an effort to reduce his rival's commanding lead in shipbuilding contracts. StarDrive lured [[Walex Blissex/Legends|Walex Blissex]], Kuat's finest starship designer, away from KDY, but his daughter [[Lira Wessex/Legends|Lira]] was as capable a naval architect as he, and in any case, the Republic's war effort during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] was too dependent on KDY's secret facilities and specialized shipyards for Blissex' departure to be a crippling blow.<ref name="TEGTW" />

Desperate for contracts, StarDrive agreed to a Republic offer to work with KDY in the [[Victor Initiative Project]] on the design of the [[Victory-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory''-class Star Destroyer]].<ref name="TNEC" /><ref name="ISB" /> The move was intended by the Republic to help retain Rendili's industrial capacity, but many of the company's licensee yards defected to the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]]. In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], a Separatist coup on Rendili installed the [[Independent Provisional Government of Rendili|Independent Provisional Government]], which declared for the Confederacy. Republic and Separatist warships [[Battle of Rendili|battled]] for control of the [[Rendili Home Defense Fleet]] and the planet's shipyards, and though the Republic won the day, StarDrive's days as the galaxy's greatest shipbuilder were over.<ref name="TNEC" /><ref name="TEGTW" />

===The Galactic Civil War===
In the era of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Rendili was less favored by the government and the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] owing to its divided loyalties during the Clone Wars, and it shifted much of its work to weapons platforms. Alarmed by the Empire's militarism, Walex Blissex defected to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].<ref name="TEGTW" /> However, StarDrive's older ships remained in widespread use, and they remained one of the few facilities that could construct spaceframes significantly larger than [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyers]]. This included special weapons platforms and large battleships.<ref name="TISWU">''[[The Illustrated Star Wars Universe]]''</ref> Rendili was one of the original sponsors of the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]].<ref name="HSATCSSB" />

Although the company received few notable contracts during the course of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], it continued to research new technologies and designs, and was commissioned by the Rebel Alliance to develop what would become the [[Assault Frigate Mark II/Legends|Assault Frigate Mark II]], based on Rendili's earlier dreadnaught designs.<ref name="SW:EAW:POGG">[[Star Wars: Empire at War: Prima Official Game Guide|''Star Wars: Empire at War'': Prima Official Game Guide]]</ref>

After the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], Blissex' [[Republic-class Star Destroyer|''Republic''-class Star Destroyer]] design was billed by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] as a StarDrive product. In reality, this was a political move to lure Rendili away from the Empire, as its bulbous, organic lines suggested a [[Mon Calamari Shipyards/Legends|Mon Calamari Shipyards]] design.<ref name="CTD">''[[Cracken's Threat Dossier]]''</ref>
